## Current objective
Add a CSV import for vendor credits in `ledgerly/imports/vendor_credits.py`; finance needs it this week. The SQLAlchemy upgrade and ordered GitHub Actions workflow migration are on hold. The privacy-retention ticket/sign-off objective is paused and no retention behavior has been changed.

## Recent work
Webhook retries are complete: `WebhookSender` retries transport and retryable server errors with bounded exponential backoff, while 4xx errors fail immediately. Validation: 8 webhook tests and all 44 repository tests pass; Ruff and `git diff --check` pass.

Search rebuild performance was improved: invoice scans are tenant-scoped, document embedding uses up to eight workers with ordered results, and requests are chunked by 100. A 5,000-invoice dry run completed in 1.19s. Search validation passed 33 tests. An `EXPLAIN ANALYZE` confirmed tenant filtering uses `invoices_tenant_updated_idx`. Other rebuild entry points were found in `ledgerly/management/commands/rebuild_search.py`, `ledgerly/search/rebuilder.py`, and a tenant migration helper that may still use per-document embedding.

A GitHub Actions test workflow was created, but integration jobs must no longer target the retired `ci-runner-small` pool; use `ci-runner-arm64`. The workflow still needs adjustment and validation.

Latest check of `invoice list --help` still shows duplicate `--currency/-c` entries, indicating another command builder has not yet adopted the shared helper. Paste exact test output in future reports.
